results.sentence: People bring questions about religion to ChatGPT more than 70 million times a week... about 22 million involve studying religious texts
results.evidence: Page says 'More than 70 million ChatGPT requests each week'; 22M study religious texts; 16M practices; 16M beliefs; Easter rise; report Faith, Community & AI; dated Oct 8, 2026.

results.sentence: BT Servant... was presented to everyday readers for the first time
results.evidence: MNN Oct 21 does not say first time or first public release; it only says the tool is accessible free via Signal/WhatsApp. Jan 9 MNN piece covers it earlier.
results.fix: Drop 'for the first time'. E.g. 'This month, Mission Network News (Oct 21) introduced unfoldingWord's free assistant BT Servant ... to general readers.'

results.sentence: The Christian Post, which says it reviewed the full report
results.evidence: CP says only 'The analysis, reviewed by The Christian Post'. Not 'the full report'.
results.fix: 'The Christian Post, which says it reviewed OpenAI's analysis, ...' Also the later 'We could not find the full report' line is fine.

results.sentence: Relevant quotes the same line [OpenAI roles belong to individuals...]
results.evidence: Relevant carries only 'is not and should not become an arbiter of religious truth'; 'Those roles belong to...' not found there (found in CP).
results.fix: 'Relevant quotes the first part of that line.'

results.sentence: Its open-source engine 'integrates OpenAI models plus ChromaDB-backed resources'
results.evidence: Quote confirmed. README does not mention a license; GitHub repo page is Public but shows no license and no LICENSE file in root (raw LICENSE 404). 'Open source' unsupported; publicly visible code is not necessarily open source.
results.fix: Replace 'open-source engine' with 'publicly posted engine' (or 'its code, posted publicly on GitHub, ...'). Quote itself is accurate.

results.sentence: unfoldingWord announced the tool in January as an aid for church-based Bible translators
results.evidence: Article dated Jan 9, 2026 uses 'church-centric' translators and says tool was announced at the Global Church-Centric Bible Translation Forum; forum date not stated. Quote 'very specific, tightly controlled library of resources' confirmed.
results.fix: 'Mission Network News reported in January that unfoldingWord had introduced the tool as an aid for church-centric Bible translators, drawing on ...'

results.sentence: Even Mission Network News asks readers to pray that users 'will use BT Servant with discernment'
results.evidence: Phrase is in the article's call to action (MNN's words, not Lindsley's); draft attributes it to MNN correctly.

results.sentence: Developer Ian Lindsley says... 'as easy to install...'; 'it's just been me'; 'constantly adding improvements'; desk/books; 'pull the answer from these trusted resources'; free; Signal and WhatsApp; 'Now, the same tools...'
results.evidence: All quotes confirmed. 'Developer' is implied (creator, 'other developers have helped'); acceptable.

results.sentence: Its site says it runs 'in the apps you already know', in several languages, with audio supported
results.evidence: Site: 'Free, in the apps you already know'; English, Indonesian, Spanish and many more; 'Audio supported'; 'Grounded in vetted biblical resources — not the open internet.'; 'Supports pastors, teachers, and translators. Never replaces them.' Draft quote of 'Grounded in vetted biblical resources' is a clean truncation.

results.sentence: data cover Sept 2025 to Sept 2026; 34%; nearly half Bible passages; 13% worship; 'People ask ChatGPT to explain difficult passages, find relevant commentaries...' ; arbiter quote + 'Those roles belong...'
results.evidence: All confirmed; CP dated Oct 20, 2026. Note 34% is of religion-related requests (draft says so).

results.sentence: Relevant reported the same shares on Oct 22
In a March interview, YouVersion CEO Bobby Gruenewald estimated... 15%... 60%; 'might not recognize...'; urges knowing Bible and trained pastors; 'He has published no method'
results.evidence: Confirmed (interview with Christian Daily International, relayed by CP, Mar 17, 2026). 'Published no method' is an absence claim; soften not needed but it reflects only this article. Consider 'The article gives no method'.

results.sentence: Calvin University is establishing the Calvin Center for Faith and Technology in its School of Engineering and Computer Science, Crosswalk reported Oct 20
results.evidence: Confirmed; Oct 20, 2026. Note Crosswalk URL is a 'guest-commentary/contributors' path (likely a press release); consider noting source is a university announcement.

results.sentence: Led by director Derek Schuurman... 'with courage, curiosity, wisdom, and discernment'... resources, workshops and panels
John 1:1... free iPhone app from Repertorium LLC... 292,374 ranked connections and 10 translations in 7 languages... 'No ads. No accounts. No in-app purchases.'
results.evidence: All confirmed. Site does not state 'new' or a launch date; draft's 'a new' / 'brand new' is unsupported by the page.
results.fix: Remove 'new'/'brand new' unless a launch date is sourced; keep 'we found no independent reviews'.

results.sentence: Sam Altman posted on Oct 3: 'I am very uncomfortable... real safety issue'
results.evidence: CP (Oct 7) says Altman posted on X Oct 3 and quotes the sentence; the fetched summary showed the quote's start and the 'real safety issue' ending. Primary X post not opened; consider citing it.

results.sentence: Luke wrote Acts for Theophilus...; Acts 17 Paul reasons in synagogue; many believed in next verse; Hebrews 10:24-25 paraphrase
results.evidence: Acts 1:1, 17:2-3, 17:12; Heb 10:24-25 match standard text (not fetched live; Scripture, low risk). Acts 17:11 WEB text should be checked against bible-api.com at publish.
